recentItems.title: Salman Khan To SUPPORT Nephew Arhaan Khan’s Bollywood Debut With Special Cameo
recentItems.description:
Salman Khan is all set to add a big star touch to Arhaan Khan’s Bollywood debut. Arbaaz Khan and Malaika Arora’s son is preparing to enter the industry as a leading man, and Salman will appear in a cameo in his first film. The yet-untitled project is being described as an action love story. Anirudh Iyer will direct it; he previously made ‘An Action Hero’, starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Jaideep Ahlawat. Producer Ashwin Varde is backing the film.

recentItems.title: Nicole Kidman & Sandra Bullock Reflect On How They’ve Changed Since ‘Practical Magic’ In 1998
recentItems.description:
It’s been 28 years, but the magic is still alive! Nicole Kidman and Sandra Bullock have reunited and revisited their iconic Practical Magic era. The reunion has delighted fans, bringing back memories of the beloved fantasy film and the unforgettable chemistry between the two stars.

recentItems.title: Mirzapur: The Movie Review: The ‘Bhaukaal’ is back! Pankaj Tripathi leads the madness | Ravi Kishan
recentItems.description:
Mirzapur: The Movie brings back the franchise’s signature mix of mass action, madness and nostalgia. Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal and Ravi Kishan deliver powerful performances, while the larger scale keeps the drama engaging. Though the familiar template feels slightly stale, loyal fans get plenty of ‘bhaukaal’ and memorable moments.
